text:
maria_sales: Hey team — need quick numbers and approvals for a POC -> enterprise conversion. Customer requires 1) audit logs retained 24 months (default 30d), 2) external KMS/HSM key custody, 3) HIPAA + SOC2, and 4) 2-year commit with predictable unit pricing. Can we get a line-item delta vs hosted rate card and any deal-desk guardrails?

alex_se: Quick Q — expected token throughput + storage volume for logs? that drives whether Dedicated makes sense.

maria_sales: POC traffic small (~50M tokens/mo) but if they go live they expect 1B tokens/mo. Logs estimate ~1.2TB/month with 2y retention -> ~28TB stored.

alex_se: OK thanks. For pricing guidance based on that: audit log retention is charged per GB/month after the 30d included. Rough estimate: `audit-storage: $0.10/GB/mo` -> 28TB ~= $2,800/mo. KMS/HSM: external KMS integration + key-encryption support is a $3k one-time integration + `kms-surcharge: $1,200/mo` for key ops and rotation hooks. If they require FIPS 140-2 HSM-backed KMS with SKMS appliance, add one-time HSM onboarding of `~$25k` and `+$2,000/mo` ops.

alex_se: SOC2/HIPAA pack: we typically treat as an enterprise compliance add-on — `SOC2/HIPAA attestation & DPA`: one-time onboarding and control alignment `~$10k` and annual attestation/assurance $8k/yr. Also require a customer-signed BAA for HIPAA.

tom_dealdesk: Heads up — discount policy: for 2-year committed ARR we can approve up to 20% discount off list, but need minimum committed ARR threshold of $250k/yr for max tier. Any special concessions (waive onboarding fees, custom SLA) need explicit approval from RevOps + Finance.

lina_finance: Confirming Tom. We can do 20% with a contract value >= $500k over 2 years, or 15% for $250k-499k. Also request adding `rev_rec` note: onboarding fees recognized over 12 months.

priya_security: Technical notes: external KMS requires proof of key separation and RPC signing; HSM on-prem connectors add ~6-8 weeks of security review and pen-test window. Also we need their security questionnaire answers before we commit to timelines. If they want full attestations included in SOW, that increases legal review time.

maria_sales: TL;DR numbers for deck: audit storage ~ $2.8k/mo, KMS base $1.2k/mo + $3k one-time, HSM extra $25k onboarding + $2k/mo, SOC2/HIPAA onboarding $10k + $8k/yr. Can we publish as a provisional add-on quote to customer?

alex_se: Yes provisional ok. Recommend offering two options in quote: Hosted + Compliance Add-on; Dedicated reserved nodes + Compliance Add-on (Dedicated reduces per-token cost at their 1B tokens/mo volume). I can run the Dedicated capacity sizing and post final unit economics by EOD.

tom_dealdesk: Maria, please attach expected ARR/commit value when you create the deal in SFDC and tag `dealdesk/compliance`. I'll queue for approval. If you want the 20% discount route, include a short business case (strategic account, reference potential).

maria_sales: Will do. One more — can we waive any onboarding fees if they commit to a 2y $1M ARR?

lina_finance: Waiving onboarding fees requires exec approval. For $1M+ 2yr we can escalate to CRO/Head of Finance for approval; pre-approved negotiable items include up to 20% discount, extended payment terms (net45) but not fee waivers.

priya_security: Also add that if they demand continuous audit log export to their SIEM (pull model), that adds network egress costs — include as separate line item.

dealbot: :white_check_mark: Deal 1752500482 submitted to deal desk queue by maria_sales. Status: pending_review.

maria_sales: Thanks — I'll push the provisional quote with both options and the 2-yr business case. Alex — ping me when you have the Dedicated numbers.

alex_se: On it. I'll post Dedicated sizing + per-token math before EOD PST.

maria_sales: Appreciate it. If legal needs anything for the BAA I'll loop in @legal.

priya_security: Put me on the legal thread for security review — will review questionnaire responses once received.
